_doc: Core rules. Tiers are chosen by the current streak (wolves caught since the last mistake). 'pelts' = pelts per wolf, 'hintCost' = Sniff price, 'activity' 0..1 = how much the flock wanders, 'mixedBreeds' = how many breeds share the field. See docs/DESIGN.md. 'quick' = [seconds for ×3 pelts, seconds for ×2] (hidden speed bonus; slower is always ×1).

mistake._doc: 'classic' = press your luck: a mistake loses every pelt you hold (spend them in the shop to bank them). 'streak' = a mistake resets the streak and costs 'peltCost' pelts.

hint._doc: Sniff: each use sends away half the innocent sheep, down to minSheep left. A tier's hintCost overrides cost.

_farmPromptDoc: Streaks that bring up the 'visit your farm' popup (a picture of the farm, with Shop / Farm / Keep hunting).

hungryWolf._doc: A special round once a day (every set of times in world.json): the wolf stalks a sheep; mouth-to-wool for 'biteSeconds' eats it and costs 'peltLoss'. Waits 'startDelay' s at round start and 'rest' s between meals. 'times' lists the time-of-day slots it may land on (one is picked per day, per run); 'everyDay' false turns it off.

wolfPack._doc: A special round once a day, never the same round as the hungry wolf: 'wolves' [at the first tier, at the top tier] disguised wolves, each with its own slip, among a flock 'sheepShare' the usual size. Find them all to clear the round; each wolf pays the tier's pelts, and the last one carries the speed bonus (time shared across the pack). 'times' = time-of-day slots it may land on.
